description: Bifolio of business accounts. Mentions many sūsiyyas and other kinds of garments; Mawāhib al-Jamrī; al-Ḥājj; Ḥasan; Nūr al-Dawla; al-Bayrūtī; ʿAbd Allāh al-Razīn(?); Ḥasan Ibn al-Qaṣṣār; Abū Bakr b. Abū l-ʿIzz. Also mentions malḥafas and rose preserves and al-Khādim, and a pair of "Būshī" fūṭas and kerchiefs.
description_he: רשימה או טבלה בArabic, Greek/Coptic Numerals, Judaeo-Arabic. מוחזק בספריית קיימברידג'.
